authority: Read-only selected source tracing of normal producer outputs; no additional export/import/font generation or mutation probes were executed

covered.reached: prepared/source images and references, transformed mask, ROI/padding/adapter audit via metadata.preparation
covered.remaining: original source mask is not stored in audit; only transformed/binarized/cropped mask survives by default
region reblit returns arrays/audit without an automatic Store recipe; callers must explicitly preserve it if used

covered.reached: metadata.placements -> each supplied raster and pixel rect in list order
covered.remaining: Explicit caller metadata can override placements in direct render_ui; pipeline does not expose metadata so normal pipeline path preserves it

covered.reached: metadata.font_atlas -> atlas image and all supplied glyph rasters/bearings/advance plus text placements
covered.remaining: Explicit font file is loaded by path then hashed later; bytes and font_info size/coverage are not bound into atlas or typed closure. Supplied-glyph atlas is intact; file-based constructor replay is incomplete

covered.reached: metadata.viseme_rasters -> all supplied rasters; letter_map/fallback/symbols/text and rational frame holds retained
covered.remaining: No missing supplied-raster lineage identified in default path; remote mouth/phoneme generation remains unsupported

required_qualifications.finding: Original source mask missing before destructive preparation
required_qualifications.source: prepare.py preparation audit includes source_rasters/source_references but no source_mask; export.py preparation branch reaches mask only
required_qualifications.recommendation: Persist typed original mask separately, retain its representation/geometry, and add a typed source_mask closure edge.

required_qualifications.finding: File-based font source and constructor settings not portable
required_qualifications.source: assets.py rasterize_font loads truetype(path) then hashes path.read_bytes; build_glyph_atlas does not accept/store font_info/rawfont
required_qualifications.recommendation: Capture font bytes once before decode (BytesIO), bind raw blob+size/coverage/color/decoder info to font-atlas, and add a typed rawfont closure edge.

required_qualifications.finding: Cross-run raw raster identity does not identify a unique encoded source
required_qualifications.source: pipeline.py sequence_owners/input_sequences recognizes in-run imports; export.py pipeline-plan has no generic arbitrary digest traversal
required_qualifications.recommendation: Expose explicit source-sequence references for cross-run rasters if original encoded identity is required; do not guess a parent from equal decoded bytes.

scope_limits: No blanket semantic approval of all editable kinds or malformed metadata
No external provider or learned source reconstruction
No arbitrary recursive scanning of64hex strings (raw blobs must remain raw)
Lineage changes requested from owner; producer files unchanged
